G0301G.name: Amos
G0301G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G0301G.brief: Son of Naum in Jesus' genealogy
G0301G.short: Amos, an ancestor of Jesus, son of Naum.

G0367I.name: Ananias
G0367I.desc: High Priest living at the time of the New Testament
G0367I.short: Ananias, the high priest, presided over Paul's trial and ordered him to be struck on the mouth for his defense.

G0367G.name: Ananias
G0367G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0367G.brief: Husband of Sapphira, lied about offering proceeds
G0367G.short: Ananias, along with his wife Sapphira, lied to the apostles about the proceeds from the sale of their property and faced divine judgment.

G0367H.name: Ananias
G0367H.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0367H.short: Ananias, a disciple in Damascus, was sent by God to heal and baptize Saul (later known as Paul) after his conversion on the road to Damascus.
